title: Roadmap Readout: Inference Economics Scenarios & Executive Ask Package
creator: Asha Kapoor
description: Purpose: Produce a concise, board-ready readout that (1) synthesizes roadmap changes impacting inference economics, (2) provides three quantified investment scenarios with P&L and runway implications, and (3) proposes a clear executive ask package (funding + operational commitments) for Q3. This ticket coordinates PM/Eng/Finance/Legal inputs, finalizes the narrative slides, and secures leadership signoff. Key focus areas: batching/quantization trade-offs, Dedicated capacity commit sizing, and risk mitigation (fallback models + canary rollouts).
acceptance_criteria: 8-slide executive packet (PDF) that can be presented to board/execs
Scenario P&L for Base / Growth / Accelerate with 12/24/36 month projections
Concrete ask phrasing (dollar amounts, term, key milestones) and fallback lane
Stakeholder signoff from Eng (runtime), Finance, Legal, and CEO
Accompanying appendix with model assumptions, sensitivity table, and links to dashboards and PRs
